seo.title: Take action with WAHHF Foundation — Donations, Volunteering, Partnerships
seo.description: Join WAHHF Foundation’s commitment: make a donation, become a trainer or a volunteer, or build an institutional partnership.

header.title: Three practical ways to support young people
header.intro: Give, share your skills or involve your organisation: here is how to take action with WAHHF Foundation, in Cameroon and in Europe.

donate.title: Donate
donate.text: Fund the free German/English/Italian courses and our social work on the ground.

volunteer.title: Become a volunteer
volunteer.text: German/English/Italian teachers, doctors, mentors or local coordinators in Cameroon and in Europe.

partner.title: Become a partner
partner.text: Schools, universities, NGOs and companies wishing to co-fund or support a programme.
